name: Gayatri BioOrganics Limited
about: Gayatri BioOrganics Limited manufactures and sells starch, liquid glucose, sorbitol, and allied products in India. It also offers gluten, corn fiber, germ, bio-theen-G, bio-oxide-G, bio-y-dext, and bio-w-dext. The company was formerly known as Gayatri Starchkem Limited and changed its name to Gayatri BioOrganics Limited in February 2008. Gayatri BioOrganics Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
